svg.text: CustA traffic from Br2 to HQ across the Inter-AS Option B link
Labels from Br2's traceroute to 10.10.0.1; 35, 1811 and 1518 from the BGP entries on B-PE1, B-ASBR and A-ASBR; 1103 from A-ASBR's
MPLS forwarding table; RTs from the BGP entries on B-PE1 and A-PE1. Interface names from the baseline and stage configs.
HQ's route, 10.10.0.1/32, advertised from right to left
SR LSP to 10.2.0.8: 16800, popped at B-P1
LDP LSP to 10.1.0.5: 1103, popped at A-P1
Each stack is the packet on that link, outermost header on top. Blue boxes: the routers with VRF CustA.
